URL: https://www.ipsos.com/en-uk/labour-now-lead-8-points-conservatives-second-place-latest-voting-intention-polling
Published 25 October 2026. Fieldwork 15-22 October 2026. 1,109 British adults 18+, Ipsos UK KnowledgePanel.
Voting intention: Labour 32% (+5), Conservatives 24% (+3), Reform UK 20% (-3), Lib Dems 9% (+1), Greens 8% (-5).
Labour lead of 8 points — largest with Ipsos since June 2025; first time Conservatives second.
Government: 23% satisfied (+5), 66% dissatisfied; net -43.
Leaders: Burnham 35% satisfied / 45% dissatisfied; Badenoch 35/39; Polanski 17/56; Farage 22/64; Davey 20/42.
Ready for government: Reform UK 19% (down from 22%); Conservatives 24% (+4).
Best party: Reform leads on asylum/immigration (28% vs Labour 14%); Labour leads on healthcare (27% vs Con 11%) and cost of living (21% vs Con 13%).
Keiran Pedley, Ipsos: "The Labour Party under Andy Burnham is resurgent, consolidating voters on the left behind them."
